faqs.question: How far in advance should I book?
faqs.answer: For charter and private hire, please allow at least 24 hours so we can confirm vehicle availability. Daily Express tickets can be booked online up to one hour before departure.

faqs.question: What size coach do I need?
faqs.answer: Our fleet runs from 19 to 98 seats. Under 20 passengers suit a mini coach; 20–35 a midi coach; 36–53 an executive coach; and larger groups can choose a 72-seat or double-decker vehicle. Ask for a quote and we will advise.

faqs.question: Are your coaches ULEZ-compliant?
faqs.answer: Yes — the entire fleet is Euro-6 and fully ULEZ-compliant, so there are no extra charges for journeys inside London's Ultra Low Emission Zone.

faqs.question: Are your drivers DBS-checked?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every driver holds a current Enhanced DBS check and a full UK PCV Category D licence — especially important for our home-to-school services.

faqs.question: How do I request a quote?
faqs.answer: Use the Get a Quote page and tell us your travel date, group size and journey. Our team aims to reply within 24 hours.

faqs.question: How do I contact NP Coaches?
faqs.answer: Use our contact form, call 0208 843 1000 or email Info@np-coaches.co.uk. We aim to respond to enquiries within 24 hours.

faqs.question: Where does the Daily Express pick up in London?
faqs.answer: The London corridor stops are Southall at 1A Priory Way and Slough Library, Stop W, opposite the Moxy Hotel on Wellington Street. Check the timetable before travelling.

faqs.question: What luggage can I bring on the Daily Express?
faqs.answer: Each ticket includes one 20kg suitcase in the hold and one 7kg item of hand luggage. Extra luggage may incur a surcharge, so please contact us before travelling.

faqs.question: How do I book a Daily Express ticket?
faqs.answer: Choose Book tickets under Daily Express, select your stops, journey date and number of passengers, then complete secure payment online.

faqs.question: Have you got a timetable?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Daily Express timetable lists current times, stops and route information for London, the Midlands and Leicester. Please check it again on your day of travel as times can change.

faqs.question: How do I register my child for school transport?
faqs.answer: Visit Home to School, choose the relevant school and follow the secure ShuttleID or ticket portal link. The school page includes its routes, pass information and any waiting-list guidance.

faqs.question: Where can I read your privacy policy and terms?
faqs.answer: Both documents are available from the footer. They explain how we handle personal data, cookies, bookings, luggage and passenger travel.

faqs.question: What is NP Coaches' story?
faqs.answer: New Punjab Coaches Ltd has been family-run since 1999. From our Iver depot in West London, we provide coach travel for schools, businesses, tours, private groups and scheduled passengers across the UK.

pages.title: About NP Coaches
pages.subtitle: Family-run coach hire from West London since 1999.
pages.body:
New Punjab Coaches Ltd, trading as NP Coaches, has provided premium coach hire from West London since 1999. What began as a family business is today run by the founder's sons, operating a modern fleet of 15+ Euro-6, ULEZ-compliant coaches from 19 to 98 seats.

We carry schools, businesses, tour groups, wedding parties and sports teams UK-wide, and run the daily Daily Express scheduled service between London and the Midlands. Safety and compliance come first: DBS-checked drivers, GPS-tracked vehicles and a full UK PSV operator licence.

Our depot is at Willow Tree Farm, Love Lane, Iver, Buckinghamshire SL0 9QZ.
pages.seoTitle: About NP Coaches | Family-Run Coach Hire Since 1999
pages.seoDescription: NP Coaches is a family-run West London coach operator established in 1999, with a Euro-6 ULEZ-compliant fleet from 19 to 98 seats serving schools, tours and events UK-wide.

pages.title: Frequently Asked Questions
pages.subtitle: Booking, pricing, routes and luggage — answered.
pages.body:
Booking & quotes

How do I request a quote? Use our Get a Quote page — tell us your dates, group size and journey and we aim to reply within 24 hours.

How far in advance should I book? For charter and private hire we recommend at least 24 hours so we can confirm vehicle availability. For the Daily Express scheduled service, online tickets can be booked up to 1 hour before departure.

What size coach do I need? Our fleet runs 19, 35, 53, 72, 86 and 98 seats. Under 20 passengers suit a 19-seat mini coach; 20–35 a midi; 36–53 a 53-seat executive; 54+ a 72-seater or double-decker. See the full fleet.

Daily Express

Where does it pick up in London? Southall (1A Priory Way) and Slough (Library, Stop W, opposite the Moxy Hotel, Wellington St, SL1 1YG). See the timetable.

What luggage can I bring? One 20kg suitcase in the hold plus one 7kg item of hand luggage, included in your ticket. Extra luggage incurs a surcharge. Please arrive 15 minutes before departure.

School transport

How do I register my child? Visit Home to School and follow the link to the ShuttleID portal for your school.

Fleet & emissions

Are your coaches ULEZ-compliant? Yes — the entire fleet is Euro-6 and fully ULEZ-compliant, so there are no extra charges for journeys inside London's Ultra Low Emission Zone.

pages.title: Lost Property
pages.subtitle: Left something on board? Here's how to reclaim it.
pages.body:
Think you've lost something on one of our coaches? Report it online with your travel date, time, route and a description of the item, and we'll check whether it has been handed in.

A £5 administration charge (plus VAT) applies on reclaimed items, covering handling and storage. Items must be reclaimed from our Iver depot within 7 days of travel to avoid additional storage costs. Lost property is held for a maximum of 14 days, after which it is disposed of.

You can also call 0208 843 1000 or email Info@np-coaches.co.uk with your journey details. We use your contact details only to reunite you with your property and hold them for no longer than one month.
pages.seoDescription: Lost something on an NP Coaches service? Report it with your travel details. A £5 admin fee applies on collection; items are held at our Iver depot for 14 days.

pages.title: Safeguarding
pages.subtitle: Protecting the children and young people who travel with us.
pages.body:
New Punjab Coaches Ltd takes the safeguarding of children and young people extremely seriously. We believe it is never acceptable for a child or young person to experience abuse of any kind, and we recognise our responsibility to safeguard and promote the welfare of every child who travels with us.

We recognise that

  • The welfare of the child or young person is paramount.
  • All children — regardless of age, ability, gender, racial heritage, religious belief, sexual orientation or identity — have an equal right to protection from harm and abuse.
  • Working in partnership with children, parents, carers and other agencies is essential to promoting young people's welfare.

We safeguard children by

  • Valuing, listening to and respecting them.
  • Adopting child-protection guidelines through clear procedures and a code of conduct for staff.
  • Sharing information about safeguarding and good practice with children, parents and staff.
  • Sharing concerns with the agencies who need to know, involving parents and children appropriately.
  • Recruiting safely — every driver holds a current Enhanced DBS check — and preventing the deployment of unsuitable individuals.
  • Keeping confidential, accurate records of any safeguarding concern, securely stored.

Responsibilities

Every member of staff has a responsibility to safeguard children and a duty to report concerns wherever they arise. All staff must read and sign our full safeguarding policy, which sets out roles and responsibilities, how to record and escalate concerns, the levels of safeguarding risk, and our whistleblowing procedures.

This policy is reviewed every two years, or sooner in response to changes in legislation or guidance.
pages.seoDescription: NP Coaches' commitment to safeguarding children and young people: DBS-checked drivers, clear child-protection procedures and a duty on all staff to report concerns.

pages.title: Driver Vacancies
pages.subtitle: Join a friendly, professional West London coach team.
pages.body:
We're always interested in hearing from safe, professional and friendly drivers. As a driver with NP Coaches you'll operate our school services, private hire, airport transfers and day tours, with a variety of work patterns to suit. To apply or ask about current openings, contact us via the contact page — we aim to reply within 48 hours.

What you'll need

  • A valid UK PCV licence (Category D)
  • Aged 21 or over
  • A genuine commitment to great customer service
  • The ability to load and unload passenger luggage

What we offer

  • A competitive hourly rate
  • Guaranteed 45 paid hours per week, with overtime available
  • Free smart, comfortable uniform
  • Paid annual leave
  • No vehicle washing, refuelling or cleaning at the end of your shift

Please note

We're proud of our health-and-safety record and operate a drugs-and-alcohol policy applicable to all employees. As part of your initial assessment, and at random during employment, you may be subject to testing.

pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.subtitle: How we collect, use and protect your personal data.
pages.body:
Last updated: 22 August 2026.

This policy explains how New Punjab Coaches Ltd, trading as NP Coaches ("we", "us"), collects and uses personal data when you use np-coaches.co.uk, book travel, request a quote or use our services. We are the data controller and process personal data under the UK GDPR and Data Protection Act 2018.

What we collect

  • Contact and enquiry data — your name, email, phone number and information you provide when contacting us, requesting a quote or reporting lost property.
  • Booking data — journey, passenger and payment-confirmation details needed to provide travel.
  • Payment data — Stripe processes card payments; we do not store full card details.
  • Technical and analytics data — device and browser information, referring site, pages viewed, interactions and approximate location. Google Analytics is used only after you consent. We deliberately send page paths without query strings and do not intentionally send form entries, booking details or other directly identifying information to Analytics.

How and why we use information

  • To provide travel and services you request — performance of a contract.
  • To answer enquiries, improve our services and protect the site — legitimate interests.
  • To meet safety, licensing and accounting duties — legal obligation.
  • To measure website use with Google Analytics 4 — your consent, which you may withdraw at any time.

Google services

After analytics consent, the Google tag loads Google Analytics 4 and Google provides us with usage reports. Google Search Console provides aggregated information about how the site appears in Google Search and does not require us to place an analytics cookie on your device. Links to Google Maps open Google's service, where Google's own privacy terms apply. See Google's Privacy Policy.

Sharing and international processing

We share data only with providers needed to operate our services, including Directus hosting, Stripe, our email provider, Google (where you consent to Analytics), and school-ticketing providers, or with authorities where law requires. We do not sell personal data. Some providers may process data outside the UK; where this happens we require an approved transfer mechanism and appropriate safeguards.

Retention

We keep personal data only for as long as needed for its purpose or legal obligations. Analytics reports follow our Google Analytics retention settings; analytics cookies can remain on a device for up to two years unless you withdraw consent or delete them. See our Cookie Policy.

Your rights and choices

You may request access, correction, erasure, restriction, objection or portability where applicable. Use the site's Cookie settings control to withdraw analytics consent. To exercise a data right, email Info@np-coaches.co.uk. You may complain to the Information Commissioner's Office at ico.org.uk.

Contact

New Punjab Coaches Ltd, Willow Tree Farm, Love Lane, Iver, Buckinghamshire SL0 9QZ. Phone 0208 843 1000. Email Info@np-coaches.co.uk.
pages.seoDescription: How NP Coaches collects, uses and protects your personal data under the UK GDPR and Data Protection Act 2018, including your rights and how to contact us or the ICO.

pages.title: Cookie Policy
pages.subtitle: How and why we use cookies on this site.
pages.body:
Last updated: 22 August 2026.

Cookies are small text files stored on your device. NP Coaches uses them in line with the UK GDPR and Privacy and Electronic Communications Regulations (PECR).

Essential cookies

  • np_consent — remembers whether you accepted or rejected analytics for up to one year. This preference cookie is essential to respect your choice.
  • Short-lived security and session cookies may be used for account, booking and payment functions. They are set only when needed to provide a feature you request.

Google Analytics cookies

We use Google Analytics 4 (measurement ID G-3GXSRDBP55) to understand aggregate site use. The Google tag is blocked until you actively choose Accept analytics. If accepted, Google Analytics may set:

  • _ga — distinguishes visitors; default expiry up to two years.
  • _ga_<container-id> — maintains session state; default expiry up to two years.

Advertising storage, ad personalisation and Google signals remain disabled. Analytics receives page paths without query strings; we do not intentionally send form entries, passenger details, payment data or booking references.

Google Search Console and Maps

Google Search Console gives us aggregated search-performance reports and does not require an analytics cookie from this website. Links to Google Maps take you to Google's service and are governed by Google's Privacy Policy.

Change or withdraw your choice

Use the Cookie settings button shown on every page. Rejecting analytics stops future Analytics requests and removes first-party Google Analytics cookies accessible to this site. You can also delete or block cookies in your browser; essential features may then work differently.

Questions? Email Info@np-coaches.co.uk.
pages.seoDescription: How NP Coaches uses essential and analytics cookies under UK GDPR and PECR, and how you can manage or withdraw your cookie consent at any time.

pages.title: Daily Express Timetable
pages.subtitle: Current scheduled coach times between London, the Midlands and Leicester.
pages.body:
Check the current Daily Express departure times for all scheduled journeys. Services connect Southall and Slough with Coventry, Birmingham and Wolverhampton every day, with Leicester services operating Friday to Monday.

Times and pickup points can change, so please use the live Daily Express timetable before travelling. Online tickets must be booked at least one hour before departure and passengers should arrive 15 minutes early.

For timetable help, call 0208 843 1000 or email Info@np-coaches.co.uk.

pages.title: Terms & Conditions
pages.subtitle: The terms that apply to our services and bookings.
pages.body:
These terms govern your use of the NP Coaches website and the services you book with New Punjab Coaches Ltd. By booking travel or using our site you accept these terms. They are governed by the law of England and Wales.

Bookings & payment

  • Quotes for charter and private hire are confirmed in writing; prices are calculated for your specific journey.
  • Daily Express tickets must be booked at least 1 hour before departure. Online tickets are discounted and non-refundable.
  • Card payments are processed securely by Stripe.

Travel & luggage

  • Please arrive at least 15 minutes before the scheduled departure time. Services depart on time and cannot wait for late passengers.
  • Each Daily Express ticket includes one 20kg suitcase and one 7kg item of hand luggage; additional luggage may incur a surcharge.
  • We carry passengers only between authorised stops and cannot offer door-to-door drop-offs on scheduled services.

Liability

We are not responsible for personal items left on board — see our Lost Property page. Nothing in these terms limits any liability that cannot be limited under law, including for death or personal injury caused by our negligence. Your statutory rights as a consumer are unaffected.

Contact

New Punjab Coaches Ltd, Willow Tree Farm, Love Lane, Iver, Buckinghamshire SL0 9QZ. Phone 0208 843 1000. Email Info@np-coaches.co.uk.

blogPosts.excerpt: From a 19-seat mini coach to a 98-seat double decker — a quick guide to picking the right vehicle for your trip.
blogPosts.author: NP Coaches
blogPosts.body:
Picking the right coach is mostly about passenger numbers, but luggage, comfort and budget matter too. As a rough guide: under 20 passengers suit our 19-seat mini coach; 20–35 fit a 35-seat midi; 36–53 are well served by a 53-seat executive; and larger groups step up to a 72-seater or one of our double-deckers.

For tours with luggage, leave a little headroom on capacity so everyone travels in comfort. Not sure? Get a quote and we'll recommend the right vehicle for your itinerary.

blogPosts.title: What ULEZ-compliant means for your coach hire
blogPosts.excerpt: Our entire fleet is Euro-6 and ULEZ-compliant — learn what that means for a straightforward, lower-emission London coach journey.
blogPosts.author: NP Coaches
blogPosts.body:
ULEZ is London's Ultra Low Emission Zone. It is designed to encourage cleaner vehicles and improve air quality by applying a daily emissions charge to vehicles that do not meet the required standard when they travel within the zone.

For a group trip, that can affect the cost and planning of a journey. Every coach in the NP Coaches fleet meets the Euro-6 emissions standard and is fully ULEZ-compliant, so you can travel into London without a ULEZ surcharge being added to your coach-hire quote.

What ULEZ-compliant actually means

ULEZ compliance is about the vehicle's emissions standard, rather than its age alone. Euro-6 is the modern emissions standard used by our coaches. In practical terms, it means the vehicle meets the requirements to operate in London's ULEZ without the daily ULEZ charge that can apply to older, more polluting vehicles.

Why it matters for coach hire

London journeys often involve a lot of moving parts: school visits, hotel drop-offs, theatre trips, airport transfers, sporting fixtures and event timetables. A compliant coach keeps one potential cost out of the equation, helping you plan a clear, straightforward quote from the start.

  • No ULEZ surcharge added to your NP Coaches quote for a compliant vehicle.
  • Confidence for journeys into central and outer London.
  • A lower-emission fleet choice for schools, businesses, tour groups and private events.

What it means when you travel with NP Coaches

ULEZ compliance is one part of the standard we set for every vehicle. Our fleet covers 19 to 98 seats, so we can match the coach to your passenger numbers, luggage and itinerary while keeping your London travel simple. Whether you are arranging a school trip, wedding, corporate transfer or UK tour, our team will build the right vehicle into your quote.

Planning a journey in London

When you ask for a quote, share your travel date, pick-up points, destination, passenger numbers and any luggage or access requirements. We will use that information to recommend a suitable coach and plan the journey with you. If your itinerary changes, let us know as early as possible so we can help keep the day running smoothly.

Frequently asked questions

Do passengers need to pay a ULEZ charge?

No. ULEZ is a vehicle emissions scheme, not a passenger charge. As our fleet is Euro-6 and ULEZ-compliant, there is no ULEZ surcharge to add to your NP Coaches coach-hire quote.

Does ULEZ compliance make a difference outside London?

It is particularly useful for London itineraries, but a modern Euro-6 fleet also supports lower-emission travel wherever your group is going.

Can you help us choose the right coach?

Yes. Explore the fleet to see the available sizes, or request a quote and our team will recommend a coach for your journey.
